eos_boundary.description: EOS handles business operations (agents, tasks, portfolios, CRM, workflows). CreatorOS handles creator product/distribution/community.
overlap_areas: CRM — both have contacts tables (EOS: crm_contacts, CreatorOS: contacts)
Revenue tracking — both track revenue (EOS: business analytics, CreatorOS: creator revenue)
AI agents — both have AI chat/agent features (EOS: multi-provider, CreatorOS: OpenAI only)
eos_boundary.boundary_note: Overlap is architectural — will need reconciliation when both apps are production. UMH projection layer is the intended integration point.

questions.question: Which MVP scope is canonical? Three conflicting definitions exist.

options.B: Creator + Course/Product (content + community + courses + products, recommended)
options.C: Creator + Full Distribution (content + community + courses + cross-platform + analytics, large)
options.D: Full PRD Scope (everything including marketplace, ads, UGC, multistreaming, massive)
